These pictures represent activities related to children' -- so item_text is the codebook's own verbal description of each picture rather than a stem a child read. See the public_note. VERBATIM DEVIATION: the codebook's item (i) reads 'read stories form the Bible'; shipped as 'read stories from the Bible', the obvious typo corrected and disclosed here. No other wording was altered -- 'play the happy surgeon' (the paper's Measures section glosses it as playing Operation(TM), Hasbro) and 'give seat up for an elderly person on a bus' are the codebook's own phrasings and are shipped unedited. MAPPING paper_order, Step 5b route 8, status PARTIAL. The processing script data/meloni_2015_disability.py melts the S1 workbook columns IA1_REL_1_TIME .. IA4_GEN_5_TIME and applies str.removesuffix('_TIME'), so the IRW item code IS the source column name minus that suffix -- core-model pattern 2, a mechanical rename, no positional step. What that fixes is the four BLOCKS (religious / human body / social / general, 5 items each), which the codes name outright and the paper's own description of the four tasks confirms. What it does NOT fix is position 1..5 within a block: the S2 codebook lists the 20 activities as a flat roman-numbered list (i)..(xx) tied to no codes, so the within-block order is inferred from that list order. The inference is corroborated by the frequency data (verify_meloni_2015_child_ia_frequency.R): 7/7 content predictions hold, including say prayers as the most frequent religious activity (4.25, 72.0% weekly), searching the internet about disease as the least frequent human-body activity (1.81, 62.7% never), help-a-classmate highest and push-a-wheelchair lowest in the social block (3.77 vs 1.42, 75.0% never), play-a-sport highest and visit-a-museum lowest in the general block (4.71, 86.7% weekly vs 2.50, 2.7% weekly), play-a-sport the maximum and push-a-wheelchair the minimum of all 20, and read-a-newspaper below watch-the-TV-news (2.03 vs 3.72). PARTIAL rather than VERIFIED because IA2_HBODY_2/_4/_5 (watch a TV programme about health / play the happy surgeon / play doctor) have means 2.23/2.24/2.23 and floor 45.3/44.0/47.3% -- no distributional route separates that trio, and their order rests on the codebook list alone.
